inventory.answer: Knight of the Order of the Sword

decision.explanation: Two distinct awards are directly supported by the provided sources. From document d1, Hideo Kojima is explicitly described as being conferred the 'title of Knight of the Order of the Sword,' which aligns with the award name 'Order of the Sword' and is consistent with the ceremonial context. This is a single award, so both the title and the award name refer to the same entity. From document d2, it is stated that Kojima received the 'Academy Fellowship Award' at the 2020 BAFTA Games Awards, with supporting references. These two awards are separate and valid based on the original context. The third candidate, 'Knight of the Order of the Sword,' is redundant with the first and does not represent a distinct award.
